text: Recommendations for protein intake are generally based on grams per kilogram of body weight. Research studies used to derive these guidelines have been carried out in men and women with approximately 10% to 20% body fat. Extrapolating these results to reflect requirements based on fat-free mass results in values of 2.0 to 2.6 g/kg/day for men (14) and 1.8 to 2.2 g/kg/day for women (152).
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
